symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins extending into long yellow-white streaks.
Oozing yellow bacterial droplets on leaf surfaces during humid mornings.
Wilting and yellowing of entire tillers (kresek stage).
management_recommendations: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L combined with Streptocycline @ 0.5 g/L.
Avoid excessive nitrogenous fertilizer application during active infection.
Maintain proper field drainage to prevent bacterial spread across standing water.
prevention_measures: Use certified disease-resistant seeds (e.g., Swarna-Sub1, MTU 1010).
Treat seeds with Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/kg before sowing.

symptoms: Spindle-shaped diamond lesions with brown margins and greyish centers on leaves.
Neck rot / browning at the panicle node causing chaffy unfilled grains.
Oval brown spots on leaf blades reducing photosynthetic foliage.
management_recommendations: Foliar spray of Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L of water.
Apply Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 mL/L or Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2 mL/L.
Apply recommended Potassium (MOP) to improve stem wall strength and fungal resistance.
prevention_measures: Avoid high plant density; ensure proper sunlight penetration.
Refrain from top-dressing Nitrogen when ambient humidity exceeds 80%.

symptoms: Small raised pustules containing reddish-brown or black powdery spores.
Premature leaf drying and leaf necrosis along upper canopy.
Reduced grain weight and impaired photosynthesis.
management_recommendations: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 mL/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.5 mL/L.
Apply Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L as preventive cover spray.
Destroy and burn infected crop residue immediately post-harvest.
prevention_measures: Adopt crop rotation with non-host legume crops.
Maintain recommended spacing between rows for foliage aeration.

symptoms: White to greyish powdery flour-like fungal patches on leaves and stems.
Stunted pod development and reduced marketable yield.
management_recommendations: Spray Wettable Sulfur 80% WP @ 3.0 g/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1.5 mL/L.
Spray Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) @ 50 mL/L for organic suppression.
Prune dense lower foliage to enhance air movement.
prevention_measures: Plant in locations receiving direct sunlight.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation late in the evening.

symptoms: Vibrant green leaf blades free from fungal pustules, bacterial streaks, or spots.
Normal cell turgidity and uniform vegetative expansion.
Healthy root system and optimal tillering.
management_recommendations: Continue standard balanced NPK fertigation schedule.
Maintain routine monitoring for early pest or disease signs.
Ensure timely weed control and optimum irrigation depth.
prevention_measures: Follow standard crop protection and soil health maintenance practices.
